question: The Nalanda University was built in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Magadha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Nalanda University was an ancient center of higher learning in the Indian state of Bihar, located in the region historically known as Magadha.
 
• The university was established during the Gupta Empire in the 5th century CE.
 
• Nalanda was a renowned Buddhist monastery and educational institution that attracted scholars from across Asia.
 
• It is considered one of the first residential universities in the world, providing accommodation to both students and faculty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Historical Significance:** Nalanda University was an esteemed seat of learning and intellectual exchange in ancient India.
 
• **Courses Offered:** The university offered studies in various fields such as theology, grammar, logic, astronomy, metaphysics, and medicine.
 
• **Library:** Nalanda had a vast library called "Dharmaganja," which housed numerous manuscripts and texts.
 
• **Destruction:** The university faced destruction around the 12th century during the invasions by Turkic Muslim invaders, particularly Bakhtiyar Khilji.
 
• **Revival:** Efforts to revive Nalanda University have been undertaken in modern times, with the establishment of a new Nalanda University in 2010.
